name: mijia-mcp-server
description: Productized Mijia MCP server built on top of mijia-api 3.x with layered capability control for reusable device capabilities, homes, and scenes.
author: Mijia MCP Team

resources.name: Service Status
resources.description: Server metadata, auth file path, and runtime status

resources.name: Homes
resources.description: All homes and rooms in a user-friendly format

resources.name: Devices
resources.description: All devices with room and home information

resources.name: Capability Catalog
resources.description: Standardized capability classes and preferred product-level tools

resources.name: Tool Catalog
resources.description: Everyday tools, advanced tools, and the recommended workflow for clients

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Get connection, auth, file location, and runtime status

tools.name: reconnect_service
tools.description: Reconnect the service and optionally force QR login

tools.name: clear_saved_login
tools.description: Clear saved login credentials so the next connect uses QR login

tools.name: list_homes
tools.description: List all homes and rooms with room-level device counts; can act as a fallback when home overview is unavailable

tools.name: refresh_devices
tools.description: Refresh homes, devices, and room mappings from Mijia cloud

tools.name: get_tool_catalog
tools.description: Return the recommended everyday tools, advanced tools, and workflow

tools.name: get_home_overview
tools.description: Return a room-first overview of homes and devices for everyday browsing

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List devices by name, room, home, model, and online status

tools.name: get_device
tools.description: Resolve a single device and return summary, capabilities, and common state

tools.name: get_device_status
tools.description: Return current state and recommended next actions for one device

tools.name: get_device_capabilities
tools.description: Resolve a single device and return a standardized capability schema for stable client routing

tools.name: control_device
tools.description: Unified device control entry point built on capability abstractions such as power, brightness, color temperature, target temperature, and mode

tools.name: control_by_intent
tools.description: Route a natural-language-like smart-home request to the best product tool

tools.name: turn_on_device
tools.description: Turn on a device

tools.name: turn_off_device
tools.description: Turn off a device

tools.name: set_brightness
tools.description: Set brightness for any brightness-capable device

tools.name: set_color_temperature
tools.description: Set color temperature for any color-temperature-capable device

tools.name: set_target_temperature
tools.description: Set target temperature for any target-temperature-capable device

tools.name: set_hvac_mode
tools.description: Set mode for any mode-capable device such as an air conditioner, fan, or purifier

tools.name: set_fan_speed
tools.description: Set fan speed for any fan-speed-capable device such as a fan, air conditioner, or purifier

tools.name: set_cover_position
tools.description: Set position for any cover-capable device such as a curtain or blind

tools.name: list_scenes
tools.description: List scenes globally or within a home

tools.name: execute_scene
tools.description: Execute a scene by scene name or scene id

tools.name: get_consumable_items
tools.description: Get consumable items globally or within a home

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Test server connectivity
